proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha
  have key : ∀ x : ℝ, 4 * a * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) = (2 * a * x + b) ^ 2 - (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) := by
    intro x
    ring
  have hneg : (∃ x : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) := by
    refine ⟨(|b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| + 1 - b) / (2 * a), fun hp => ?_⟩
    have h := key ((|b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| + 1 - b) / (2 * a))
    have e : 2 * a * ((|b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| + 1 - b) / (2 * a)) + b = |b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| + 1 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [e] at h
    have h3 : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c ≤ |b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| := le_abs_self _
    have h4 := abs_nonneg (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)
    have h5 : 0 < 4 * a * (a * ((|b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| + 1 - b) / (2 * a)) ^ 2 + b * ((|b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| + 1 - b) / (2 * a)) + c) := by
      rw [h]
      nlinarith
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (by positivity : 0 < 4 * a)).1 h5
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0⟩ := hneg
  have hv := key (-b / (2 * a))
  have e0 : 2 * a * (-b / (2 * a)) + b = 0 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [e0] at hv
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have ha0 : a < 0 := by
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ha with h1 | h1
        · exact h1
        · exact absurd (h x0) (not_lt.2 (hx0 h1).le)
      refine ⟨ha0, ?_⟩
      nlinarith [h (-b / (2 * a)), mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg ha0 (h (-b / (2 * a)))]
    · rintro ⟨ha0, hD⟩ x
      by_contra hn
      push_neg at hn
      nlinarith [key x, sq_nonneg (2 * a * x + b), mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.2 ha0.le) hn]
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have ha0 : a < 0 := by
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ha with h1 | h1
        · exact h1
        · exact absurd (h x0) (not_le.2 (hx0 h1))
      refine ⟨ha0, ?_⟩
      nlinarith [h (-b / (2 * a)), mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.2 ha0.le) (neg_nonneg.2 (h (-b / (2 * a))))]
    · rintro ⟨ha0, hD⟩ x
      by_contra hn
      push_neg at hn
      nlinarith [key x, sq_nonneg (2 * a * x + b), mul_pos (neg_pos.2 ha0) hn]
